description.value:
The Mk. 31 HMG was engineered with two functions in mind: 1) mounting on armored vehicles, 2) installing on defensive perimeters. In other words, it was meant as a bolted-down heavy-hitter. No one inside Militech ever considered anyone could or would want to carry this massive gun anywhere whether they were loaded with cyberware or not. But, as usual, it seems the human will found a way. The Mk. 31 HMG can sometimes be found cradled in the arms of heavily chromed solos and gangoons, as they're the only people capable of withstanding its recoil. However, the Mk. 31 cannot be reloaded easily in combat situations, effectively making it a one-hit wonder. Still, by the time this beast’s clip is emptied, there's typically no one left to shoot at anyway.

Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)

Class: Excellent Quality Machine Gun • Skill: N/A • Range: N/A

Damage: N/A • Capacity: 300 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Gun 5), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only use Autofire and Suppressive Fire, both of which expend 20 rounds per use. When making an Autofire Attack with this weapon, if the DV to hit is only beat by 1, the Attack still has an Autofire Rating of (x2). Reloading this weapon requires three Reload Actions. Requires BODY 11+ to be wielded unless Mounted, and BODY 13+ to not reduce MOVE by 2 while wielded. A Nomad may choose to receive this weapon when they first install a Vehicle Heavy Weapon Mount.

Range: N/A
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 5), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Autofire and Suppressive Fire only; 2d6 is the standard Autofire damage.
  • Autofire only, so its DV table is the Autofire table.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
